_comment: A bundle is either a rule (membership computed from derived attributes, so new policies join automatically) or curated (an explicit list, for opinionated sets like Autopilot MVP). A bundle can be both: rule matches are unioned with 'include', then 'exclude' is subtracted. Rule semantics are AND across keys, OR within a key; list-valued attributes such as 'frameworks' and 'tags' match on intersection. Use 'frameworks' for positive framework membership and the scalar 'framework': null to mean no framework at all. 'path' drives the Building Blocks wizard drill-down.

bundles.name: Windows - CIS Level 1
bundles.description: Every Windows policy aligned to CIS Microsoft Intune for Windows 11 Benchmark Level 1. New CIS L1 policies join automatically on commit.

bundles.name: Windows - CIS Level 2
bundles.description: Windows policies aligned to CIS Level 2. Layer on top of L1; expect higher user impact.

bundles.name: Windows - CDW Standard Baseline
bundles.description: The CDW-authored Windows baseline. Everything not tagged to an external framework.

bundles.name: Windows - Defender Antivirus
bundles.description: All Windows antivirus and Defender configuration, regardless of framework.

bundles.name: Windows - Autopilot Minimum Viable
bundles.description: The smallest policy set required to stand up Windows Autopilot enrolment for a new customer. Curated by the practice, not derived. Review at each benchmark release.

bundles.name: Mobile - BYOD Baseline
bundles.description: iOS and Android app protection, restrictions and enrolment controls for BYOD.

bundles.name: Entra - CDW Endpoint Security
bundles.description: Device-based Conditional Access: compliant device, hybrid join, app protection and platform conditions. Membership is derived from the policy body, not tagged.

bundles.name: Entra - CDW Identity Security
bundles.description: User-focused Conditional Access: MFA, risk-based controls, legacy authentication and authentication strength. Membership is derived from the policy body, not tagged.

bundles.name: Entra - Conditional Access CIS L1
bundles.description: Conditional Access policies mapped to CIS Level 1. Requires the 'cis-l1' tag on the policy sidecar.

bundles.name: Entra - Conditional Access CIS L2
bundles.description: Conditional Access policies mapped to CIS Level 2. Requires the 'cis-l2' tag on the policy sidecar.

bundles.name: Entra - Zero Trust Framework
bundles.description: Conditional Access policies forming the Zero Trust reference architecture. Requires the 'zero-trust' tag on the policy sidecar.

bundles.name: Entra - Tenant Configuration
bundles.description: Tenant-level Entra objects: authorization policy, device registration, cross-tenant access, admin consent requests and directory settings.

bundles.name: Entra - Core Conditional Access Starter
bundles.description: The three-policy minimum for a new tenant: admin MFA, risk-based password change, legacy authentication block.

goals.title: Harden devices to a security baseline
goals.outcome: Applies the CIS-aligned hardened device configuration: Defender, firewall, encryption, credential protection and attack surface reduction.

goals.title: Apply the full CDW standard baseline
goals.outcome: The complete CDW-authored device baseline, covering security, user experience, browser, Office and update management.

goals.title: Stand up modern device enrolment
goals.outcome: The minimum viable set to bring new devices into management with Autopilot: hardening, encryption, LAPS, local admin control and passwordless sign-in.

goals.title: Deploy antivirus and threat protection
goals.outcome: Microsoft Defender Antivirus configuration, update rings and attack surface reduction rules.

goals.title: Protect company data on personal devices
goals.outcome: App protection and enrolment restrictions so corporate data stays contained on unmanaged iOS and Android devices.

goals.title: Establish core Conditional Access
goals.outcome: The three-policy minimum every tenant should have: multifactor authentication for administrators, risk-based password change, and legacy authentication blocked.

goals.title: Secure user and administrator sign-in
goals.outcome: Conditional Access covering multifactor authentication, risk-based controls and blocking of legacy authentication.

goals.title: Require managed or compliant devices
goals.outcome: Device-based Conditional Access so corporate resources are only reachable from compliant, managed or app-protected devices.

goals.title: Harden tenant-wide identity settings
goals.outcome: Tenant configuration: authorization policy, device registration, cross-tenant access, admin consent and directory settings.

goals.title: Apply a Zero Trust identity framework
goals.outcome: The Conditional Access set forming a Zero Trust reference architecture. Populated by tagging policies in Policy Management.

towers.name: Microsoft Entra ID
towers.blurb: Identity, Conditional Access and tenant settings

towers.name: Exchange Online
towers.blurb: Mail flow, anti-spam and mailbox policy

scenarios.title: New tenant foundation
scenarios.outcome: Everything needed to stand up a greenfield tenant: core Conditional Access, tenant-wide identity hardening, and Windows Autopilot enrolment.

scenarios.title: Secure the Windows estate
scenarios.outcome: Hardens Windows devices to CIS Level 1, deploys Defender antivirus and attack surface reduction, and requires managed devices for access.

scenarios.title: Enable bring-your-own-device
scenarios.outcome: Lets staff use personal phones safely: app protection on iOS and Android, enrolment restrictions, and device-based Conditional Access.
